verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-invoked bulk operation, such as selecting many PRs, findings or issues and acting on them together. Automatic review of every new PR, the auto-fix toggle, repo-wide codebase scans and per-item MCP triage are automation features that sit next to bulk operations but are not the capability itself. No documented API or bulk-action interface appears either; the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
